'''Category:Templates''' collects the reusable page shapes of this demo wiki.
A template lives in the <code>Template:</code> namespace and is rendered with
double braces; its parameters are filled at the call site.

== Members ==

* [[Template:OmniFact]] - the small fact box used by the article pages

== Why templates matter here ==

The demo wiki mirrors the omniagent wiki, where the same facts (which rule is
active, where it lives, whether it shipped) recur across many pages. Putting that
recurring row in one template keeps the article bodies about the subject instead
of about the markup.
